title: Acute Stroke Program of Interventions Addressing Racial and Ethnic Disparities
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to increase treatment of acute stroke with tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) across the District of Columbia. This study, however, will not evaluate tPA as an intervention.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* diagnosis of acute ischemic stroke
* over the age of 18

Exclusion Criteria:

\-
study_population: Adult residents of the District of Columbia
